idea-plugin.name: OTel Collector Drift Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the removed components and renamed attributes in an OpenTelemetry Collector config before the upgrade does

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → OTel Collector Drift Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 39 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/otel-collector-drift-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/otel-collector-drift-lint

action.text: OTel Collector Drift Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run OTel Collector Drift Lint on the file in the editor
